description: This file is a shell script for managing git subtrees, providing commands for splitting, merging, adding, pulling, and pushing subtrees within a git repository. It includes command parsing, utility functions, and processing logic specific to git subtree operations.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Prints a message to stdout if not in quiet mode.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Prints debug messages to stderr if debug mode is enabled.

methods.name: progress
methods.description: Displays progress updates, with special formatting for debug mode.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Ensures a command executes successfully; otherwise, terminates with an error.

methods.name: die_incompatible_opt
methods.description: Handles incompatible options for specific commands.

methods.name: cache_setup
methods.description: Initializes cache directories for split operations.

methods.name: cache_get
methods.description: Retrieves cached revision mappings.

methods.name: cache_miss
methods.description: Lists cache misses for given revisions.

methods.name: check_parents
methods.description: Verifies parent revision history in cache.

methods.name: set_notree
methods.description: Marks a revision as not a subtree commit.

methods.name: cache_set
methods.description: Stores a mapping from old to new revision in cache.

methods.name: rev_exists
methods.description: Checks if a revision exists in the repository.

methods.name: try_remove_previous
methods.description: Attempts to remove a previous revision if it exists.

methods.name: process_subtree_split_trailer
methods.description: Processes commit trailers related to subtree splitting.

methods.name: find_latest_squash
methods.description: Finds the latest squash commit in history.

methods.name: find_existing_splits
methods.description: Finds existing subtree split points in history.

methods.name: copy_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit based on a revision with copied metadata.

methods.name: add_msg
methods.description: Generates an add message with optional metadata.

methods.name: add_squashed_msg
methods.description: Generates a message for squashed merge commits.

methods.name: rejoin_msg
methods.description: Creates a message for rejoining a split subtree.

methods.name: squash_msg
methods.description: Creates a message detailing a squash operation.

methods.name: toptree_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the root tree of a commit.

methods.name: subtree_for_commit
methods.description: Finds the subtree directory in a commit.

methods.name: tree_changed
methods.description: Checks if a subtree tree has changed compared to its parent.

methods.name: new_squash_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit representing a squash of changes.

methods.name: copy_or_skip
methods.description: Decides whether to copy a commit or skip based on tree similarity.

methods.name: ensure_clean
methods.description: Ensures working directory and index are clean before operations.

methods.name: ensure_valid_ref_format
methods.description: Checks if a ref name is valid.

methods.name: should_ignore_subtree_split_commit
methods.description: Determines if a commit should be ignored based on subtree trailers.

methods.name: process_split_commit
methods.description: Processes a commit for splitting or merging subtrees.

methods.name: cmd_add
methods.description: Handles adding a commit or repository as a subtree.

methods.name: cmd_add_repository
methods.description: Fetches and adds a remote repository as a subtree.

methods.name: cmd_add_commit
methods.description: Adds a specific commit as a subtree.

methods.name: cmd_split
methods.description: Splits out a subtree into a separate branch.

methods.name: cmd_merge
methods.description: Merges a commit into the current subtree.

methods.name: cmd_pull
methods.description: Fetches and merges remote changes into the subtree.

methods.name: cmd_push
methods.description: Pushes subtree commits to a remote repository.
